H8283.name: Sarah
H8283.desc: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
H8283.brief: Wife of Abraham; mother of Isaac
H8283.short: Sarah (or Sarai) was the wife of Abraham and the mother of Isaac, through whom God fulfilled His promise to make Abraham a great nation.

H8294.name: Serah
H8294.desc: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H8294.brief: Daughter of Asher, sister of Asher's sons
H8294.short: Serah was the daughter of Asher and the sister of Asher's sons, as mentioned in the genealogies of the tribe of Asher.

H8286.name: Serug
H8286.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H8286.brief: Son of Reu; father of Nahor, ancestor of Abraham
H8286.short: Serug was the son of Reu, the father of Nahor, and an ancestor of Abraham, living to the age of 230 years.

H8223.name: Shapham
H8223.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8223.brief: Gadite leader during the reign of Jotham
H8223.short: Shapham was a leader of the Gadites who lived in Gilead during the reign of Jotham, king of Judah.

H8227B.name: Shaphan
H8227B.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8227B.brief: Scribe during the reign of King Josiah
H8227B.short: Shaphan, the scribe, played a significant role in the religious reforms of King Josiah and the events surrounding the fall of Jerusalem to the Babylonians.

H8227G.name: Shaphan
H8227G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8227G.brief: Father of Jaazaniah, an idolatrous worshipper
H8227G.short: Shaphan was the father of Jaazaniah, one of the seventy elders of Israel who were involved in idolatrous practices in the temple.

H8202K.name: Shaphat
H8202K.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8202K.brief: Overseer of David's herds in the valleys
H8202K.short: Shaphat, the son of Adlai, was appointed by King David as the overseer of his herds that grazed in the valleys.

H8202I.name: Shaphat
H8202I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8202I.brief: Descendant of David during the postexilic period
H8202I.short: Shaphat was a descendant of King David who lived during the postexilic period, as recorded in the genealogies of 1 Chronicles.

H8202J.name: Shaphat
H8202J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8202J.brief: Gadite leader during the reign of Jotham
H8202J.short: Shaphat was a leader of the Gadites who lived in Bashan during the reign of Jotham, king of Judah.

H8202H.name: Shaphat
H8202H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8202H.short: Shaphat was the father of Elisha, the prophet who succeeded Elijah and performed many miracles during the reigns of the kings of Israel.

H8202G.name: Shaphat
H8202G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H8202G.brief: Spy from the tribe of Simeon
H8202G.short: Shaphat, the son of Hori, was the spy representing the tribe of Simeon who was sent to explore the land of Canaan.

H8298.name: Sharai
H8298.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8298.brief: Israelite who divorced his foreign wife
H8298.short: Sharai was one of the Israelites who had married a foreign woman and agreed to divorce her as part of Ezra's religious reforms.

H8272G.name: Sharezer
H8272G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8272G.brief: Assyrian prince who assassinated his father Sennacherib
H8272G.short: Sharezer, along with his brother Adrammelech, assassinated their father, King Sennacherib of Assyria, and fled to the land of Ararat.

H8272H.name: Sharezer
H8272H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8272H.brief: Delegate sent to inquire about fasting
H8272H.short: Sharezer was part of a delegation sent to the house of God to inquire about the necessity of fasting in the fifth month.

H8203I.name: Shephatiah
H8203I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8203I.short: Shephatiah, a Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag while he was hiding from Saul.

H8203J.name: Shephatiah
H8203J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8203J.brief: Ruler of the Simeonites under David
H8203J.short: Shephatiah, the son of Maacah, appointed as the ruler over the tribe of Simeon during David's reign.

H8203H.name: Shephatiah
H8203H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8203H.short: Shephatiah, a Benjamite who lived in Jerusalem, descended from Jeroham.

H8203K.name: Shephatiah
H8203K.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8203K.brief: Son of King Jehoshaphat of Judah
H8203K.short: Shephatiah, one of the sons of King Jehoshaphat of Judah, who received gifts from his father.

H8203G.name: Shephatiah
H8203G.desc: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
H8203G.short: Shephatiah, the fifth son of David, born to him and his wife Abital in Hebron.

H8203L.name: Shephatiah
H8203L.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8203L.brief: Ancestor of exiles who returned to Jerusalem
H8203L.short: Shephatiah, whose descendants were among the exiles who returned to Jerusalem from Babylon.

H8203M.name: Shephatiah
H8203M.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8203M.brief: Ancestor of Solomon's servants who returned from exile
H8203M.short: Shephatiah, whose descendants were among Solomon's servants who returned to Jerusalem from Babylon.

H8203O.name: Shephatiah
H8203O.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8203O.short: Shephatiah, the son of Mattan, an official during King Zedekiah's reign who opposed Jeremiah.

H8203N.name: Shephatiah
H8203N.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8203N.brief: Judahite who settled in Jerusalem after exile
H8203N.short: Shephatiah, a descendant of Judah who settled in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

H8274G.name: Sherebiah
H8274G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8274G.brief: Levite who assisted Ezra and Nehemiah
H8274G.short: Sherebiah, a Levite who played a significant role in assisting Ezra and Nehemiah in their respective missions.

H8274H.name: Sherebiah
H8274H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8274H.brief: Levite who sealed the covenant and led worship
H8274H.short: Sherebiah, a Levite who sealed the covenant and led worship during Nehemiah's time.

H8230.name: Shiphi
H8230.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8230.brief: Simeonite descendant of Ziza in Hezekiah's time.
H8230.short: Shiphi was a Simeonite descendant of Ziza who lived during the reign of King Hezekiah.

H8225.name: Shiphmites
H8225.brief: People from Siphmoth who oversaw David's vineyards.
H8225.short: The Shiphmites were people from Siphmoth who were in charge of King David's vineyards.

H8236.name: Shiphrah
H8236.desc: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H8236.brief: Hebrew midwife who feared God and disobeyed Pharaoh.
H8236.short: Shiphrah, along with Puah, was a Hebrew midwife who feared God and disobeyed Pharaoh's command to kill male babies.

H8204.name: Shiphtan
H8204.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H8204.brief: Father of Kemuel, a leader from the tribe of Ephraim.
H8204.short: Shiphtan was the father of Kemuel, a leader from the tribe of Ephraim appointed to help divide the Promised Land.

H8206H.name: Shuppim
H8206H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8206H.short: Shuppim was a Levite who served as a gatekeeper during the reign of King David.

H8206G.name: Shuppim
H8206G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H8206G.brief: Benjamite descendant, son of Ir or Iri.
H8206G.short: Shuppim was a Benjamite descendant, the son of Ir (or Iri), mentioned in the genealogy of Benjamin.

H8289G.name: Lasharon
H8289G.brief: A Canaanite city conquered by Joshua
H8289G.short: Lasharon, a Canaanite city whose king was defeated by Joshua (<ref="Joshua 12:18">Joshua 12:18</ref>).

H8208.name: Shaphir
H8208.short: Shaphir was a town mentioned in Micah's prophecy, urged to pass on in nakedness and shame (<ref="Mic. 1:11">Mic. 1:11</ref>).

H8289I.name: Sharon
H8289I.brief: Coastal plain known for its beauty and fertility
H8289I.short: Sharon was a coastal plain known for its beauty, fertility, and pastureland (<ref="1Chr. 27:29; Sng.2.1; Isa. 33:9; 35:2; 65:10; Act.9.35">1Chr. 27:29; Sng.2.1; Isa. 33:9; 35:2; 65:10; Act.9.35</ref>).

H8289H.name: Sharon
H8289H.brief: Region where Gadites pastured their flocks
H8289H.short: Sharon was a region east of the Jordan where the Gadites pastured their flocks (<ref="1Chr. 5:16">1Chr. 5:16</ref>).

H8287.name: Sharuhen
H8287.brief: Town allotted to Simeon within Judah's territory
H8287.short: Sharuhen, also called Shaaraim or Shilhim, was a town allotted to the tribe of Simeon within Judah's territory (<ref="Josh. 19:6; 1Chr. 4:31; Josh. 15:32">Josh. 19:6; 1Chr. 4:31; Josh. 15:32</ref>).

H8221.name: Shepham
H8221.brief: Landmark on the northeastern border of the Promised Land
H8221.short: Shepham was a landmark on the northeastern border of the Promised Land, between Hazar-enan and Riblah (<ref="Num. 34:10-11">Num. 34:10-11</ref>).

H8219.name: Shephelah
H8219.brief: Lowland region between Judean hills and coastal plain
H8219.short: The Shephelah was the lowland region between the Judean hills and the coastal plain, known for its fertile valleys and strategic importance (<ref="Josh. 9:1; 10:40; 2Chr. 28:18; Jer. 17:26; 32:44; 33:13">Josh. 9:1; 10:40; 2Chr. 28:18; Jer. 17:26; 32:44; 33:13</ref>).

H8234.name: Shepher Mount
H8234.short: Mount Shepher was a place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness wanderings between Kehelathah and Haradah (<ref="Num. 33:23-24">Num. 33:23-24</ref>).

H8224.name: Siphmoth
H8224.brief: Town in southern Judah that received spoils from David
H8224.short: Siphmoth was one of the towns in southern Judah that received a share of the spoils from David after he defeated the Amalekites (<ref="1Sam. 30:28">1Sam. 30:28</ref>).
